For example, start nvim, run Unite file_rec, wait several seconds, do several `j` keypresses, `Ctrl-C`, and then quit. I'm afraid I can't get beyond running Unite file_rec with my Vimscript skills.

issue.title: Compatibility layer using a Neovim remote plugin?
issue.body:
This is just speculation, but would it make sense to create a compatibility layer between vimproc's api that uses Neovim's remote plugin feature?

Could it make Unite's sources work better with Neovim, [avoiding segfaults](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/issues/5234)? (I know this is a Neovim bug in itself, but I will think a discussion about compatibility with Neovim could be interesting)

In the least, it would enable Neovim users to use Vimproc compatible plugins without having to build the entire project.
